Usenet, torrents through debrid services, a door for Sonarr and Radarr, tokens with rights, a container image, a manual, and errors that say what to do. Every change is listed in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/knightloader/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

## ✨ Added

- **Sonarr, Radarr and Prowlarr can hand work over** through qBittorrent's and SABnzbd's APIs at `/api/qbittorrent` and `/api/sabnzbd`, with an API token as the password. Each grab gets a folder of its own, so an import never deletes other downloads.
- **Usenet through TorBox or Premiumize.me.** An `.nzb` is fetched by the service and downloaded like any other link.
- **Torrents through a debrid service**, with import from the debrid account, file rules and extra or banned trackers for the built-in torrent client.
- **Twelve more debrid services**, spoken to directly, and each connected hoster login as its own row on the priority card. A download's backend can be chosen in its properties.
- **API tokens carry rights** (read, add, control, admin), and KnightLoader runs under a path behind a reverse proxy.
- **Programs on events**, with the process group ended cleanly when a program stops.
- **Captchas in the Android app**, hCaptcha solving, and reCAPTCHA Enterprise and v3.
- **playmate.to videos and pasted stream playlists download.** `.m3u8`, `.m3u` and `.mpd` links, and playlists behind other names, go to yt-dlp.
- **Renaming a package moves its files**, running downloads included.
- **A manual** at [junkerderprovinz.github.io/knightloader](https://junkerderprovinz.github.io/knightloader/).
- **A container image of KnightLoader itself**, `ghcr.io/junkerderprovinz/knightloader`, for amd64 and arm64. Every release publishes it beside the relay image.
- **The desktop app for ARM64** on Windows and Linux.
- **Download buttons at the top of the README** for the desktop apps, the container, the Android app and the browser extension. Each one leads to the newest build: the desktop zips also come under a name without the version, and the app and the extension each have a standing release, `mobile/latest` and `extension/latest`.

## 🎨 Design

- **Noto Sans** in the web interface, the phone app and the browser extension, and GlimStone 2.13's motion, glyphs and buttons.
- **The Downloads and Collector toolbars stay on one line**, folding step by step when room runs short. The right-click menu is as tall as its entries, and rows carry marks for "stop after this one" and disabled links.
- **The settings have 21 tiles instead of 24**, grouped by task, with explanations behind (i) bubbles across the app.
- **The web interface fits a phone.**
- **The crest on the About card is gone**, and with it the only place the build's revision was drawn. `/api/health` still answers with the revision.

## ⚡ Improved

- **Errors say what went wrong and what to do, in your language**, in the web interface and the app. A package whose link failed to download or unpack shows that too.
- **Disable is the one way to park a link.** Hold is gone, held links become disabled on upgrade, and single links can be disabled in the app too.
- **One name for each thing** across the interface, the docs and the app.
- **A row shows one status**, without JDownloader's own state word beside it.
- **"Start now"** replaces "Force to the front", and pausing a selection pauses its waiting links too.
- **Buy Me a Coffee and PayPal open in a window inside the app.** The PayPal window asks how often and how much, and takes a card without a PayPal account.
- **A release goes public only with its downloads and images built**, so the download buttons and the in-app update check never find a release with nothing on it. "Latest", on the release and on the images, goes only to the newest published version.
- **The browser extension's send button says what it sends**: the page, a link, an image, a selection, or the links a Click'n'Load button handed over. It reads the tab's address only when you press send and no longer asks for the `activeTab` permission. On Firefox it needs version 140 or later and declares at install which data it sends.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **Sonarr and Radarr no longer delete other downloads after an import.**
- **API keys no longer appear in AllDebrid and TorBox errors.**
- **Torrents:** two with the same name no longer share a folder, removal after seeding works, and a magnet can no longer land in a foreign folder.
- **Unpacking:** errors name the part they failed in, RAR sets with encrypted contents try the saved passwords, and a failed unpacking cleans up its folder.
- **Downloads:** a removed download stays removed, a download with part of its file missing is no longer marked finished, debrid downloads land in the folder the list shows, and the speed limit takes hold within seconds.
- **A page whose player nothing supports fails with a reason** instead of JDownloader saving its scripts and images.
- **A captcha that failed to load and then loads takes back its failure mark.**
- **A database upgrade cut short no longer keeps KnightLoader from starting.**
- **The Linux and macOS zips hold a program that starts.** They are zipped on the machine that builds them, so the execute bit survives.
- **The crypto window has a visible way out**, a close button in its footer. Escape and a click beside the window were the only ones before.
- **Browser extension:** a send from the toolbar popup no longer gets lost, switching Click'n'Load off also stops the `jdcheck.js` answer, and leaving the group deletes the browser's random member ID.
- **The relay no longer logs client IP addresses**, and deletes a failed address's rate-limit record within 61 minutes of its last attempt. Its backoff for failed handshakes keeps growing to 50 minutes for a caller that tries one connection at a time.

## 🌐 Translations

- Every new and reworded text in all 42 languages, in the web interface and the app. The app now keeps a translation ledger like the web interface, so no English text slips in unnoticed. Danish and Swedish call a text selection "markering".

## 📋 Notes

- `/api/controls` is gone. `POST /api/tasks/hold` stays as the older name of `/api/tasks/enabled`.
